$comment: FROZEN BY BATCH B-01a (Local Mutation Freeze). AUTHORITY = Repository Recovery Authority; this file confers no constitutional authority and legislates nothing. The active hook list is deliberately EMPTY so that no local filesystem event can trigger an automatic repository mutation. RATIONALE: the hook preserved verbatim in $frozen_hook_B01a fired 00-BOOK/tools/register.sh on the creation of ANY .md/.txt/.docx file anywhere in the tree. register.sh runs the REG-AUTO-001 Atomic Registration Transaction over the eligibility universe returned by 00-BOOK/tools/ukb.py _repo_artifact_paths(), which is `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` — tracked UNION untracked-not-ignored. Because 00-BOOK/DATA/id-ledger.json is append-only and path-keyed, every such run minted PERMANENT universal identities for untracked, unadjudicated artifacts and regenerated tracked 00-BOOK/** content. Measured consequences at the time of freezing: 166 registered-but-untracked ledger sources (62 minted in a single hour), 7 unresolvable ledger sources, one artifact holding two identities (UCOS-PLT-000052 dangling plus UCOS-PLT-000056 live, 28 pages consumed), 29 identities minted for paths the working-tree .gitignore declares NON-ARTIFACTS, and page_cursor advanced to 10732. FAIL-CLOSED PROPERTY: if the hook loader ignores unknown keys, no hook fires because `hooks` is empty; if a loader were strict about unknown keys, this file fails to load and no hook fires either. Both outcomes satisfy the freeze. SCOPE: this freeze is LOCAL ONLY. It does not alter .github/workflows/ucos-registration-gate.yml, which still runs register.sh --guard on every push (that is batch B-01c), and it does not alter the five SessionStart programme hooks that regenerate tracked 00-MASTER/** content (that is batch B-01b). NOT A DELETION: no registration capability is removed. register.sh, ukb.py and config.py are untouched and registration remains available on explicit, reviewed invocation. RESTORE: `git checkout -- .kiro/hooks/auto-register-artifact.json` returns this file to its HEAD state byte-for-byte; the HEAD content is additionally captured in the B-00 recovery package (TRACKED.sha256).

$frozen_hook_B01a.$comment: The original hook definition, preserved verbatim and inert. Re-arming it is a deliberate act that must not occur until the registration eligibility policy is reconciled (config.py REGISTRATION_SCOPE declares 'version-controlled repository artifacts' while ukb.py:697 admits untracked-not-ignored files) and the append-only ledger damage has been dispositioned.
$frozen_hook_B01a.name: REG-AUTO-001 / UMB-IMP-001 Automatic Artifact Registration
$frozen_hook_B01a.description: Fires the REG-AUTO-001 Atomic Registration Transaction (register.sh, now bracketed by the UMB-IMP-001 pre/post enforcement gates) whenever ANY corpus artifact (.md/.txt/.docx) is created anywhere in the repository, so the Artifact Registry, Control Tower, Digital Twin, Execution Status, Traceability, and Navigation Portal stay synchronized with the filesystem with no manual step. Eligibility is decided by config.py (EXCLUDE_DIR_PREFIXES/INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS) — no program/volume/family is hard-coded here, so every future family participates automatically (AUTH-INF-001 infinite expansion). register.sh is re-entrancy-guarded, so its own regenerated pages never cause a loop.
